name: @penguinharness/clinical-feedback-loop
description: Capture colleague feedback, import minimal Excel sheets, curate issue clusters and conflicts, and publish approved read-only memory packs.

penguin.description_zh: 收集同事反馈，导入极简 Excel，整理问题聚类与冲突，并把管理员批准的内容发布成只读、带版本的 Memory Pack。
penguin.short_description: Capture feedback and publish reviewed read-only memory packs.
penguin.short_description_zh: 收集反馈并发布审核后的只读记忆包。

quick_start.prompt: Initialize the clinical feedback store for this Project, then explain which Agent receives feedback-capture, feedback-curator and curated-memory-reader.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 为这个 Project 初始化临床反馈目录，再说明哪个 Agent 应安装 feedback-capture、feedback-curator 和 curated-memory-reader。

penguin.title: Clinical Feedback Loop
